THE BOARD
The board is the full main block of a MacBook keyboard: 47 keys (letters, number row, punctuation), addressed by touch-typing finger and row (rows: num, top, home, bottom); '-in' marks index-finger inner reach; '-out'/'-o1'/'-o2'/'-o3' mark pinky outer-reach columns. Your job: work out which symbol is on which key (note: the backslash symbol is written "\\" inside JSON strings).

EACH TURN
- You press exactly 5 DIFFERENT keys (a chord) by giving their addresses.
- Next turn you are told which 5 symbols those keys held, as a list sorted in the same fixed order as the symbol list above. You are NOT told which symbol came from which key. Overlap your chords cleverly to pin symbols to keys.

ROTATIONS
After your presses each turn, some keys may be ROTATED: the letters on the rotated keys are rearranged among those same keys, and every rotated key ends up with a different letter than it had (the set of letters on those keys is unchanged; only their places among those keys change). Next turn you are told exactly WHICH keys were rotated, but not how they were rearranged. Rotations continue for the ENTIRE game and never stop: there is no rotation-free endgame.

LOCKS (optional, side score)
On any press turn you may lock letters onto keys you are sure of: +1 point if correct at that moment, -3 if wrong. You get no feedback on locks during the game. Each key can be locked only once, ever.

FINAL GUESS
You may end the game at any time by submitting your full guess. After turn 36 you MUST submit it. Your main score is how many of the 47 keys you guess correctly, judged against the arrangement at the moment you guess.

ADDRESS RELABELING
Every 6 turns the ADDRESSING ITSELF changes: two same-shaped finger columns swap addresses, and you are told which (e.g. 'the L-ring and R-index columns have swapped addresses'). The hidden symbols do NOT move when this happens — only what you must call each key changes. Every notice and every press/lock/guess you make uses the NEWEST addressing. Relabelings compose over the game: always track what each address currently means.

RESPONSE FORMAT
Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no other text.
To press: {"presses": ["L-pinky-num-out", "L-pinky-bottom", "L-ring-bottom"]}
To press and lock: {"presses": [ ... 5 addresses ... ], "locks": {"L-pinky-num": "`"}}
